bootstrap.generator: Python random.Random seeded by big-endian SHA256(seed + NUL + partition); sorted eligible source story IDs; N randrange(N) draws per replicate
bootstrap.unit: eligible story, jointly carrying both evaluator-half means and all twelve axes
bootstrap.interval: pointwise conditional 95% percentile interval, linear interpolation at (B-1)*p for p=.025 and .975
bootstrap.undefined: retain each undefined draw without replacement; withhold interval for an axis if any draw is undefined
bootstrap.coverage: parent minimum two ratings in each half; require identical eligible story membership across all axes within a partition

interpretation.scope: Descriptive story-resampling uncertainty conditional on the observed ratings, evaluator pool and fixed split. Story exchangeability is an assumption, not certified by this run.
interpretation.timing: Retrospective extension of already-published point estimates; this method and seed are frozen before the new bootstrap execution. Not a prospective confirmation protocol.
interpretation.excluded_uncertainty: No evaluator resampling, alternate-split variability, shared-rater dependence inference, topic/condition clustering, new human votes, simultaneous family coverage, human-ceiling certification, model alignment or promotion.
interpretation.confirmation: Decode only source_story_id and partition from the source manifest; CSV lexical scanning may visit every byte, but confirmation ratings and story prose are never field-decoded or converted. Evaluator IDs from every partition define the unchanged global split.
